name: cl-corporate-income-tax
description: Chile first category tax (impuesto de primera categoría, IDPC) of companies for tax year 2026 (año comercial 2026, declared in April 2027, año tributario 2027) under DL 824 art. 14 and art. 20. Covers the general semi-integrated regime of art. 14 A at 27% for 2026 under Ley 21.850 (falling to 25.5%, 24% and 23% from 2027), the Régimen Pro Pyme of art. 14 D No. 3 at 12.5% for 2025 to 2027 under Ley 21.755 art. 25 (15% in 2028), its eligibility (capital up to 85,000 UF at start, average gross income up to 75,000 UF, no year above 85,000 UF, passive income up to 35%), the transparency option of art. 14 D No. 8, the savings incentive of art. 14 E, cash-basis base and instant depreciation, PPM, the 35% IDPC restitution, losses, art. 21 rejected expenses, Impuesto Adicional withholding on dividends, interest and royalties, F22 lines and penalties. Trigger on: impuesto primera categoría 2026, Pro Pyme, 14 D, 14 A, semi integrado, transparencia tributaria, PPM, Chile corporate tax. Out of scop
